title: Lesson 5 - UI-Level Hiding: Record Types, Page Layouts, Lightning Apps, Compact Layouts, Dynamic Forms
description: Given a scenario, recommend the appropriate mechanism to hide data at the user interface level.

questions.question: A company hides the Compensation custom field from the sales profile's page layout, but a report still shows the value. Why?
options: UI hiding does not secure the field from reports; FLS must hide it
The report runs in system mode
questions.explanation: Page layout hiding only affects record pages; reports, list views, and search honor FLS. The durable fix is setting the field to Hidden in field-level security, not just removing it from the layout.

questions.question: Which mechanism best tailors record-page fields and picklist values to different business processes for the same object?
questions.explanation: Record types + page layouts vary the record page and picklist values by process. Compact layouts only affect the highlight panel, and FLS/Sharing do not define processes.

questions.question: A field visible in field-level security but removed from a page layout can still leak data. Which surface is the primary leak?
questions.explanation: Reports (and list views and search) read from field-level security, so a field visible in FLS but absent from a layout still appears in reports. OWD, debug logs, and the owner field do not surface hidden-by-layout fields in this way.
